skill.name: maintenance
skill.description: File cleanup and archiving. Tidies up bloated Plans.md, session-log.md, old logs, and state files. Trigger: /maintenance, cleanup, archive, organize, split session-log. Do NOT load for: implementation, review, release, new feature development.
skill.summary: Archive completed plans, split session logs, remove old logs, and trim growing state files.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: All 29 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, fixed command substitution, intentional project paths, and Japanese text. A semantic review found a medium-severity data-loss risk because deletion and in-place truncation can run without a mandatory preview or confirmation.

remediation.issue: Log deletion and state-file truncation can permanently remove local history without a mandatory preview or confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Make dry-run the default, require explicit confirmation before deletion or truncation, and verify backups before changing state files.

content.user_title: Clean and Archive Project Maintenance Files
content.value_statement: Growing plans, session logs, and state files make project history difficult to manage. This skill archives completed work and trims selected project files.
actual_capabilities: Archives completed Plans.md tasks while excluding active work tags.
Splits old session log entries into monthly archive files.
Lists or deletes project log files older than a retention threshold.
Keeps the newest 1,000 lines of the agent trace file.
Reports line counts, moved entries, deleted files, and backup paths.
Supports plans, session-log, logs, state, and combined maintenance modes.
limitations: The workflow targets the documented .claude project layout.
Log deletion and state trimming can remove history without a mandatory confirmation step.
Usage data cleanup depends on the existing JSON structure and requires inspection.
The skill does not edit CLAUDE.md, decisions.md, patterns.md, or CHANGELOG.md.

use_cases.title: Archive Completed Plan Items
use_cases.description: Move older completed tasks into monthly archive sections while preserving active work.
use_cases.target_user: Project leads managing a large Plans.md file

use_cases.title: Split Long Session History
use_cases.description: Keep recent session entries in the main log and move older entries into monthly files.

use_cases.title: Reduce Local Log Growth
use_cases.description: Review old logs and trim growing trace files with configurable retention thresholds.
use_cases.target_user: Tooling maintainers managing local project storage

prompt_templates.title: Preview Maintenance
prompt_templates.prompt: Run maintenance in dry-run mode. List every file or entry that would be moved, deleted, or trimmed.

prompt_templates.title: Archive Completed Plans
prompt_templates.prompt: Archive completed Plans.md tasks older than seven days. Preserve active tags and report the backup path and changes.

prompt_templates.title: Split Session Logs
prompt_templates.prompt: Split session-log.md by month. Keep the most recent 30 days and report each archive file and moved line count.
prompt_templates.scenario: Reduce the size of a long session log.

prompt_templates.title: Perform Controlled Full Maintenance
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview all maintenance with a 45-day log retention period. Exclude named files, then request confirmation before any deletion or truncation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review plans, sessions, logs, and state with custom safeguards.

output_examples.input: Preview cleanup for logs older than 30 days.
Archive completed Plans.md tasks older than seven days.
output: Nine completed tasks moved to the March 2026 archive

output_examples.input: Split the session log and keep the latest 30 days.
output: The main session log changed from 620 to 180 lines
Two monthly archive files received 440 lines
Recent entries remained in the main file

best_practices: Use dry-run before every cleanup that deletes or truncates data.
Confirm synchronization and inspect backups before changing Plans.md or session history.
Set explicit retention thresholds and exclusions for each maintenance run.
anti_patterns: Do not run full maintenance without reviewing the affected files.
Do not move active tasks marked with protected work-status tags.
Do not use this skill to edit protected history or source control files.

faq.question: What files can this skill maintain?
faq.answer: It handles Plans.md, session-log.md, project logs, agent trace data, and harness usage data.

faq.question: Can I preview changes first?
faq.answer: Yes. Use dry-run mode to list planned moves, deletions, and trims without changing files.

faq.question: How are completed plans selected?
faq.answer: The workflow uses completion dates and status tags while excluding active work markers.

faq.question: Where are session logs archived?
faq.answer: Older entries are grouped by month under .claude/memory/archive/sessions.

faq.question: Does the skill create backups?
faq.answer: It requires timestamped backups before editing files over 200 lines. Other destructive workflows need stronger backup safeguards.

faq.question: Which files are protected?
faq.answer: It does not automatically edit CLAUDE.md, decisions.md, patterns.md, CHANGELOG.md, or files under .git.
